QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Soldier's Dilemma
QuestInfo.0: The Afinas soldiers are clearly disheartened. Why not lend an ear to their woes to help morale?
QuestInfo.1: The Afinas soldiers intended to defeat a pack of monsters, but they haven't had any time to rest since you've arrived at Abrup. They're exhausted, but they have a responsibility to their people. Defeat the monsters outside the enclosure, so the soldiers can take a short break.
QuestInfo.2: Vice Commander Butler reprimanded the soldiers for asking for your help.

default.0: #h0#, please take care of 50 Raging Werebeast monsters!
